description.text:
Piaget, a language model finetuned on 15k psychological and philosophical reasoning traces.

Piaget is based on Qwen3 and was finetuned on a subset of open reasoning traces from Dolphin R1 and General Reasoning.

output_type.quote: Piaget, a language model finetuned on 15k psychological and philosophical reasoning traces.

use_claim.quote: Piaget aims to reason about psychological and philosophical concepts such as self-image, emotion, and existence.

serving.notes: tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key. model_max_length there is 131072; config.json max_position_embeddings is 40960. The card's training max length is 2048. max_new_tokens 2048 is from the card example; temperature, top_k, top_p, and do_sample are from generation_config.json. The example passes only a user turn. The chat template writes a system turn only when a system message or tools are supplied. The repository has model.safetensors (596049920 BF16 parameters) and no adapter_config.json. https://github.com/gustavecortal/preference-optimization-orpo-lora/blob/master/configs/config_0.6b.yaml sets this checkpoint as base_path and output_dir roger-0.6b with ORPO; that file is a later run on top of Piaget, not the training of Piaget. No arXiv paper names this repository. The linked 2024 CMCL paper does not print Piaget or this repository id.
